professionalSummary.text: Digital Product Manager with experience owning the alert-review workflow roadmap and prioritizing the backlog with compliance operations for a transaction monitoring product at a payments company.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.

professionalSummary.text: Proven ability to run release reviews with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items in release records for six workflow releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the release review for each of the six workflow releases with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items in the release record.

professionalSummary.text: Increased the share of alerts closed within the service-level target from 71% to 88% over four months following the alert-grouping release, as reported against the documented baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over the four months after the alert-grouping release, per the compliance operations monthly report against its documented baseline of 71 percent.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated releases with engineering and compliance operations, defining responsibility boundaries where engineering set release dates and compliance approved rollout to analyst teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated releases with the engineering manager and the compliance operations lead; the engineering manager set release dates and the compliance operations lead approved the rollout to analyst teams.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release in release notes, including the inability to split grouped alerts back into individual alerts.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the release notes for each workflow release, including the known limitation that grouped alerts could not be split back into individual alerts, and the hand-over notes for analyst trainers.

experienceHighlights.text: Led the alert-grouping release, which increased alert closure rate from 71% to 88% within four months, as verified by compliance operations monthly reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over the four months after the alert-grouping release, per the compliance operations monthly report against its documented baseline of 71 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Published the alert-review workflow roadmap to the compliance director, ensuring alignment with compliance operations leadership.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.
